newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RKC RETAIN DUTCH FIRST DIVISION STATUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RKC RETAIN DUTCH FIRST DIVISION STATUS.

text.p: RKC Waalwijk kept their place in the Dutch first division for next season by winning group A of the playoffs on Sunday.
RKC secured top spot in the round-robin tournament by beating second division side Emmen 5-4 away.
The Waalwijk side ended with 15 points from six matches, five more than second division side Zwolle.
RKC were 16th at the end of the regular first division programme.
RKC are joined by NEC Nijmegen, who won group B on goal difference on Saturday.
It was the eighth time in NEC's history they have played and won the playoffs.
The Nijmegen side, who this season ended 17th in the Dutch league, finished level on points with Go Ahead Eagles Deventer, but had a superior goal difference of five.
